vcs.action.title: Action on the code host
vcs.action.what: Writes to the code host (GitLab, GitHub or Bitbucket), visible to the team. Below is exactly what will be sent.
vcs.card.ciManual: CI waiting for a manual job
vcs.error.auth: {host} rejected the credential (HTTP {status}). Check the token or log in to the CLI again.
vcs.error.cli_missing: The command {command} was not found. Install it or choose API access.
vcs.error.forbidden: {host} denied access (HTTP {status}): the token lacks the required permission. {detail}
vcs.error.no_token: Integration {id} has no token: set the secret "{ref}" in Settings.
vcs.error.not_configured: This workspace has no {kind} integration configured.
vcs.error.rate_limited: {host} rate-limited the requests. Try again in {seconds} s.
vcs.health.noToken: Integration {id} has neither a CLI nor a token configured.
vcs.probe.bitbucketRepos: On Bitbucket, issues and requested reviews are looked up in the configured repositories; none was given.
vcs.probe.cliLogin: Access uses the {command} CLI login: permissions are those of that session.
vcs.probe.mrs: {count} open merge/pull request(s) of yours or requested from you.
vcs.probe.scopesUnknown: The host does not report this token's permissions; the reads below show what it can reach.
vcs.probe.writesNeed: For the app to propose and run writes (comments, status, reviewers) the token also needs: {scopes}. Without it the app only reads.
vcs.reviewer.noAccess: {user} has no review access in the project
vcs.validate.body: request body is not in the allowed shape
vcs.validate.githubGraphql: GraphQL is only allowed to resolve a review thread or to mark a pull request ready or draft
vcs.validate.gitlabGraphql: GraphQL is only allowed for the work item status change (workItemUpdate with statusWidget)
vcs.write.guard: write to the code host (GitLab, GitHub or Bitbucket), push a branch or publish a comment
vcs.write.statusNoNode: the issue has no global id to change its status
vcs.write.statusOpenClosed: only opening or closing the issue (open, closed)
updates.title: Updates
updates.badge.title: Open Settings › Updates
updates.mode.label: How the app was installed
updates.mode.release: Published release: the app updates itself
updates.mode.source: Source tree: updates by rebuilding it
updates.mode.setting.label: Update mode
updates.reason.source: Installed by scripts/install-local.sh from a source tree that still exists.
updates.reason.package: Installed from the .deb package: the package manager (apt or dpkg) updates it. The app does not update itself.
updates.reason.dev: The app is running from source (development). Run scripts/update.sh in a terminal to install.
updates.reason.feed-missing: This build has no update feed (app-update.yml).
updates.reason.feed-placeholder: The update feed is still a placeholder (owner/repo in electron-builder.yml). Nothing is requested from the network.
updates.reason.feed-insecure: The update feed does not use HTTPS. Updates only come over HTTPS.
updates.reason.feed-unsupported: The configured update provider is not supported (use github or generic).
updates.reason.source-missing: The recorded source tree no longer exists.
updates.reason.source-unknown: There is no record of which source tree this install came from (run scripts/install-local.sh in it).
updates.signing: On Windows and macOS automatic updates only work with signed binaries (code signing). These builds are not signed yet.
updates.channel.label: Channel
updates.channel.beta.hint: Gets test versions early, with a higher chance of bugs.
updates.auto.label: Check for updates automatically
updates.auto.hint: When the app starts and then at the interval below. Off, only when you ask.
updates.interval.label: Check every
updates.last.label: Last check
updates.last.never: Not checked yet in this session.
updates.release.downloaded: Version {version} has been downloaded and is ready.
updates.release.installing: Installing version {version}. The app restarts by itself.
updates.release.busy: A ceremony, a call or a job is running. The day's state is saved, but they are interrupted.
updates.release.installOnQuit: If you prefer, it is installed the next time you quit the app.
updates.notes.title: What changed
updates.downgrade.label: Go back to the stable version
updates.downgrade.hint: You are on a beta version. This switches to the latest stable one even if it is older. It is the only way to move to an older version.
updates.source.heading: Source tree
updates.source.explain: Rebuilds from the code in {dir}, quits the app, installs the new version and opens it again.
updates.source.head: Latest on main
updates.source.remoteAhead_one: The remote (origin/main) has {count} commit the local main does not: pull in the tree to include it.
updates.source.remoteAhead_other: The remote (origin/main) has {count} commits the local main does not: pull in the tree to include them.
updates.source.fetch.label: Fetch from the remote (git fetch) when checking
updates.source.fetch.hint: Off, the check only reads the local tree and writes nothing to it.
updates.source.error.no-dir: The source tree was not found.
updates.source.error.not-a-repo: The source tree folder is not a git repository.
updates.source.error.no-main: The source tree has no main branch.
updates.source.error.commit-unknown: The installed commit ({detail}) is not in this tree.
updates.source.confirm.title: Update the app
updates.source.confirm.body: The build takes a few minutes. When it ends, the app quits and opens again on the new version. The day's ceremony and the actions stay saved; running jobs (agents, voice) are interrupted.
updates.source.started: Updating. The app stays open during the build and quits by itself at the end; follow it in {path}.
updates.source.devNote: This only works in the installed app. Here, in development, run scripts/update.sh in a terminal.
updates.error.interval: The interval must be a whole number of hours between 1 and 168.
updates.error.inactive: The updater is not active in this install.
updates.error.dev: Only works in the installed app. In development, run scripts/update.sh in a terminal.
updates.error.noSource: This install has no record of its source tree. Run scripts/install-local.sh in it.

settings.models.title: Models
settings.tools.title: Agent tools
settings.voice.title: Voice
settings.schedule.title: Schedule and notifications
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.start.title: Startup
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.hint: Applies on save. Screens that are not translated yet stay in Portuguese.
call.openAndResolve: Open the call and resolve the conflict
call.openAndResolve.novoice: Open the chat and resolve the conflict
call.explainsConflict: The call explains the conflict; the resolution happens on its own screen, in a local worktree. Nothing goes to GitLab without your "yes" to the push.
call.explainsConflict.novoice: The chat explains the conflict; the resolution happens on its own screen, in a local worktree. Nothing goes to GitLab without your "yes" to the push.
call.opening: Good morning. There are {total} activities, {blocked} blocked. I start with the blocked ones. To answer, press space, speak and press it again.
call.opening.novoice: Good morning. There are {total} activities, {blocked} blocked. I start with the blocked ones. To answer, type in the box below or tap a suggestion.
call.effectsNote: Nothing here runs in the call. Each item goes to Claude Code and waits for your "yes".
call.effectsNote.novoice: Nothing here runs in the chat. Each item goes to Claude Code and waits for your "yes".
settings.notifications.hint: Pre-daily time, new blockers (with an invitation to the call) and status changes.
settings.notifications.hint.novoice: Pre-daily time, new blockers (with an invitation to the chat) and status changes.
settings.appearance.hint: Applies when saved. The call and the dark panels stay dark in both themes.
settings.appearance.hint.novoice: Applies when saved. The chat and the dark panels stay dark in both themes.
notify.preDaily.body: The agents are ready for the call. Click to join.
notify.preDaily.body.novoice: The agents are ready for the chat. Click to join.
help.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts and voice
help.shortcuts.intro: They work on the screens with a microphone: call, unblock, gate, QA handoff, QA return, conflict and retro.
help.shortcuts.intro.novoice: Every screen works by text while voice is off: the pre-daily chat, unblock, gate, QA handoff, QA return, conflict and retro.
help.type.text: The screens where you talk to an agent have a text field ("Or type…") to write instead of speaking: type and press {key}.
help.type.text.novoice: The screens where you chat with an agent have a text field to write the answer or the question: type and press {key}.
help.voice.off.text: Off: nothing is spoken or recorded, and the app does not start the voice engine. To turn it on, go to Settings › Voice.
help.voice.off.text.novoice: Off: nothing is spoken or recorded, and the app does not start the voice engine. To turn it on, go to Settings › Voice.
help.commands.title: Voice commands in the call
help.commands.intro: In the pre-daily, the app reads what you say (no accents, lower case) before sending it to the agent. Any other sentence goes to the activity agent.
help.commands.intro.novoice: In the pre-daily, the app reads what you type (no accents, lower case) before sending it to the agent. Any other sentence goes to the activity agent.
help.cmd.end: Ends the call and shows the end of the agenda, from where you generate the minutes. Anywhere in the sentence.
help.cmd.end.novoice: Ends the chat and shows the end of the agenda, from where you generate the minutes. Anywhere in the sentence.
help.preDaily: Reads GitLab through daily-report and builds one agent per activity, blocked ones first. In the call, the moderator opens and each agent speaks in turn (about 30 seconds): what moved, the next step, the blocker and, if any, a question for you. Your answers become decisions and effects, which go to the minutes.
help.preDaily.novoice: Reads GitLab through daily-report and builds one agent per activity, blocked ones first. In the chat, the moderator opens and each agent writes in turn (a few lines): what moved, the next step, the blocker and, if any, a question for you. Your answers become decisions and effects, which go to the minutes.
help.effects.term: Run the effects of the call
help.effects.term.novoice: Run the effects of the chat
help.theme: Settings › Appearance: system, light or dark. The call and the highlight panels stay dark in both.
help.theme.novoice: Settings › Appearance: system, light or dark. The chat and the highlight panels stay dark in both.
err.conflictOpenCall: the conflict is resolved on its own screen: open the call
err.conflictOpenCall.novoice: the conflict is resolved on its own screen: open the chat
voice.err.off: Voice is off. Turn it on in Settings › Voice.
voice.err.notInstalled: Voice is not installed on this machine. Install it in Settings › Voice.
voice.health.off: Voice is off: no sidecar is started and the app works by text.
voice.section.hint: Turn it on to talk to the agents and hear the answers. While it is off, every screen works by text and the app does not start the voice engine.
voice.enable.label: Use voice
voice.enable.on: On: microphone, spoken agents and the space shortcut.
voice.enable.off: Off: everything by text, and "call" becomes "chat".
voice.enable.needsInstall: Voice is not installed on this machine yet. Choose below and install it.
voice.status.title: Voice status
voice.problem.no-python: Neither uv nor python3 was found. Install python3 (3.9 to 3.13) or uv and try again.
voice.problem.python-version: The python3 on this machine is outside 3.9 to 3.13 and there is no uv. Install uv.
voice.problem.disk-low: Not enough disk space to install.
voice.install.title: Install voice
voice.install.hint: Creates the app's Python environment, installs the packages and downloads the speech model. It needs the network and takes a few minutes; if interrupted, it resumes where it stopped.
voice.install.model.title: Speech recognition (runs on your machine)
voice.model.tiny: Minimal, {size}: the lightest and fastest, makes more mistakes.
voice.install.engine.title: Agents' voice (synthesis)
voice.engine.edge.warn: Sounds more natural, but the text the agents speak is sent to Microsoft to become audio. What you say never leaves the machine: recognition is local.
voice.engine.edge.ack: I understand: the text the agents speak will be sent to Microsoft.
voice.engine.kokoro.ok: Runs on your machine: nothing leaves it. Model found in {dir}.
voice.engine.kokoro.missing: Unavailable: kokoro-v1.0.onnx and voices-v1.0.bin were not found. Put them in {dir} and open this screen again.
voice.phase.done: Done: voice is installed and on.
voice.phase.cancelled: Install cancelled. If you try again, it resumes where it stopped.
voice.fail.edge-not-acknowledged: Confirm that you understand the text goes to Microsoft, or choose Kokoro.
voice.fail.kokoro-missing: The Kokoro files are not on this machine.
voice.fail.no-uv: Could not prepare uv. Install it with "python3 -m pip install --user uv" and try again.
voice.fail.failed: The install failed. The detail is in Settings › App errors.
voice.test.title: Test voice
voice.test.hint: Speaks a sentence and listens to it again to prove the whole chain.
voice.test.edgeNote: With Edge, the test sentence is sent to Microsoft.
voice.test.ok: It worked: heard "{heard}" ({speak} ms to speak, {listen} ms to listen).
voice.test.fail: It did not work: heard "{heard}", expected "{expected}". {error}
voice.mic.title: Microphone
voice.uninstall.title: Remove voice
voice.uninstall.hint: Deletes the Python environment and the models the app downloaded ({size}). The Hugging Face cache outside the app and the repository venv stay. The app goes back to text.
voice.options.title: Voice options
voice.web.hint: Installing and removing voice only works in the app window.
gate.assisted.ask: ask by voice or by text
voice.check.ready: This machine works: {python}, uv {uv}, {free} free. Kokoro (local): {kokoro}.
